attchmntText: Change in the Corporate Office address of Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA) of the Company
voiceSummary: Network18 Media and Investments Limited has received intimation from Registrar and Transfer Agent KFin Technologies Limited regarding a change in its corporate office address effective 1st December 2026. The new corporate office is located at 6th, 23rd, 24th, and 25th Floor, South Tower, Rajapushpa West Avenue, Survey No. 115, Kokapet, Serilingampally Mandal, Ranga Reddy District, Hyderabad, Telangana, 500 075. Shareholder correspondence should be sent to the 6th Floor, South Tower, Rajapushpa West Avenue, Survey No. 115, Kokapet, Serilingampally Mandal, Ranga Reddy District, Hyderabad, Telangana, 500075. Contact details include email nwminvestor@kfintech.com, toll-free number 1800 309 4001, and WhatsApp number 91 910 009 4099. Shareholders are advised to use the new correspondence address for all communications relating to their shareholding in the company from the effective date.
